module.name: ibm_roks_cluster_license
module.description: Apply a BNK License custom resource into an existing IBM ROKS cluster, fetching the subscription JWT from IBM Cloud Object Storage. Uses credentials from the IBM Cloud Credential Template.

required.reason: CNEInstance must be installed first — the License CRD is delivered with the BNK platform installed by the CNEInstance chain.

required.name: ibmcloud_api_key
required.description: IBM Cloud API key used to fetch cluster credentials and read the JWT from COS.

required.name: ibmcloud_cluster_region
required.description: IBM Cloud region where the existing ROKS cluster resides.

required.name: roks_cluster_name_or_id
required.description: Existing IBM ROKS cluster name or ID where the License CR will be deployed.

optional.name: ibmcloud_resource_group
optional.description: IBM Cloud resource group used for cluster discovery and COS lookup. Defaults to the value inherited from the selected IBM Cloud Credential Template, or 'default' if none is provided.

optional.name: use_cos_bucket
optional.description: Fetch the F5 subscription JWT from an IBM Cloud Object Storage bucket.

optional.name: ibmcloud_cos_bucket_region
optional.description: IBM Cloud region where the COS bucket is located.

optional.name: ibmcloud_resources_cos_bucket
optional.description: IBM Cloud COS bucket containing the F5 subscription JWT.

optional.name: f5_cne_subscription_jwt_file
optional.description: Subscription JWT filename in the COS bucket.

optional.name: jwt_token
optional.description: F5 subscription JWT token (used only when use_cos_bucket = false).

optional.name: flo_utils_namespace
optional.description: Namespace where F5 utility components are installed (License CR is created here).

key_outputs.name: license_id
key_outputs.description: Name of the License custom resource.

key_outputs.name: license_namespace
key_outputs.description: Namespace where the License CR is deployed.

required.name: ibmcloud_api_key
required.description: IBM Cloud credential template or project secret providing the API key.
